FutureLeague (previously known as Camperoo) teaches kids ages 6-12 engineering and programming with a focus on teamwork, creativity, and design thinking. Kids level up in skills while participating in hands-on projects to reach 100 hours of instruction, similar to going from white belt to black belt in martial arts. They also host corporate team building events with Fortune 500 companies to foster design thinking and innovation.

FutureLeague is a Y-Combinator backed startup based in SOMA, San Francisco.  Emmie Chang, CEO/ Founder, previously created the largest summer technology camp in Texas and math ed-tech software that was used in over 35 school districts serving hundreds of thousands of students.

We're automating the repetitive work people hate to do.
long_description.after:
Velos helps insurance carriers and MGAs automate complex, manual back-office tasks with AI workers instead of overseas teams.

We take over workflows with the same responsibility of a traditional overseas Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) firm: mapping the customer’s existing process, creating the SOP, building the automation, and continuously improving the workflow after launch. 

Unlike other "automation platforms" we don't rely on our customers to build and manage the workflow, we take over it for them like a traditional outsourcing firm.

long_description.before:
Beglaubigt.de is building the digital back-office for European founders. Our German brand Beglaubigt.de is the market-leading platform for digital company formations and notarizations - reducing GmbH incorporations from 6–8 weeks to as little as 3 days. 

Through Germany's first fully automated incorporation API, we power the formation flows of partners like Qonto, Holvi, and Sevdesk. We're now expanding the stack into ongoing business operations: registered addresses, trade registrations, bookkeeping, and the full legal back-office.
long_description.after:
Openlaw is building the legal backoffice for every company in Europe. One engine, three brands:

- Beglaubigt.de: Germany's leading platform to found, register and manage a company. GmbH/UG formations in ~7 days instead of 6-8 weeks.
- firma.de: the operating system for running a company - accounting, tax, business address and ongoing compliance.
- Registercheck.de: real-time Handelsregister data via API. Every company, every change.

Through Germany's first fully automated incorporation API, partners like Qonto and Sevdesk embed company formation directly into their products. 30,000+ customers served so far.

one_liner.after: The legal backoffice for every company. For founders and AI agents.

long_description.before:
Dialogus builds self-improving AI voice agents for enterprise operations.

Our agents handle high-volume workflows across customer support, sales, collections, and other operational functions, integrating directly with the systems enterprises already use.

Our agents continuously learn from real conversations and business outcomes: identifying where interactions fail, proposing improvements, testing those changes across thousands of simulated conversations, and deploying better versions with human oversight.

The result is AI that doesn’t just automate calls, it gets better at doing the job over time.
long_description.after:
Dialogus builds Duet, the operating layer for companies run by people and agents.

Every company now has an AI mandate, but most stall after one or two automations. The rest of operations is a long tail of workflows like claims, disputes, approvals and exceptions that run on rules nobody ever wrote down.

Duet learns how your company actually works, from the tools your team uses and the way they really do the work. It turns those workflows into agents, proves each one alongside your team before it acts, and runs it with hard limits and full audit.

Every workflow teaches Duet more about your company, so the next one goes live faster. The result: companies automate dozens of workflows, not one or two.

one_liner.after: AI agents that learn how your company actually works

long_description.before: We are building an AI operating partner that reads every record a company produces to find and prioritize value creation opportunities, including costly operational inefficiencies no one is tracking. Cerenovus warns leaders before small problems become expensive and turns weeks of manual investigation into evidence-backed answers in minutes. Every claim links to its source, and every finding is ranked by impact. Companies use it to improve their operations; private equity and advisory firms deploy it across the businesses they own or advise.
long_description.after: Snowstone helps private equity firms drive operational value creation with AI. It's like a performance improvement engagement from a top consulting firm, but built from the company's own data, delivered in one week, and with every finding traced to its source. Today, private equity firms rely on consultants to find where portfolio companies can improve. That work depends on interviews and data requests, so the conclusions are secondhand, biased by internal politics and hard to check. Snowstone goes straight to the source data. It analyzes how a portfolio company actually operates and identifies automation potential, duplicated work, process bottlenecks and key-person risk, each quantified by its EBITDA impact.

one_liner.before: AI that finds value creation opportunities across enterprise…
one_liner.after: AI-Driven Value Creation and Margin Expansion for Private Equity

long_description.before:
Workers IO verifies your entire system across millions of interleaving, faults, and timings to find the exact conditions that break the properties you care about.

Built for teams where 99.99% uptime is table-stakes.
long_description.after:
Workers IO is building deterministic simulation environments to verify mission-critical software. We run your entire system through millions of production scenarios and prove that its properties hold in every one.

The problem:

Coding agents write code faster than teams can review it. At the same time, software and the infrastructure under it grow more complex every year. Tests only checks a few cases someone wrote, in isolation, in an environment that does not match production. Making the most expensive failures reach production first.

Our solution:

We run your system unmodified in our simulation environments, against network partitions, disk failures, crashes, and clock drift. We build those fault models for you and verify every promise across millions of scenarios. Because these simulations are deterministic, every failure is perfectly reproducible. No one writes scenarios by hand, so verification becomes a compute problem.

long_description.before:
Login tells you who signed in. GrayPass verifies the expected person is still in control before consequential actions happen. We use cognitive biometrics like typing rhythm, cursor movement, scrolling, and response timing alongside session and device context to continuously establish assurance.

Before actions like approving a payment, changing admin permissions, exporting sensitive data, or letting an AI agent act on someone’s behalf, GrayPass returns allow, challenge, hold, or deny and produces signed proof tied to that action.
long_description.after:
Login tells you who signed in. GrayPass helps apps check who’s behind sensitive actions and whether they’re authorized before those actions go through.

It combines identity, device and session context with behavioral signals like typing rhythm, cursor movement and scrolling. Before a sensitive action goes through, GrayPass evaluates that evidence against your team’s policy and returns a decision: allow, challenge, hold or deny. Your app enforces the decision.

This applies to actions like exporting sensitive data, changing admin permissions or allowing an AI agent to act on someone’s behalf. Allowed actions receive short-lived, signed proof tied to the exact action and your app.

Your existing login and authentication stack stays in place.
